backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user profiles, worker registration, search, and job posting with access control and blob storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing feature IDs, affected files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries of various frontend files for documentation or tooling use.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS base theme defining OKLCH color tokens, dark mode values, and shared utility behavior.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file setting metadata and mounting the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app wiring TanStack Router routes, global providers, and shared layout with header and footer.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminGuard: Component that checks Internet Identity login and admin permissions, gating admin-only content with appropriate UI states.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminJobPo: Admin UI listing job posts with pending/all toggle, showing details and allowing approve/reject actions.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminWorke: Admin UI for reviewing, approving, rejecting, verifying, and featuring worker registrations with toggle between pending and all workers.
frontend/src/components/common/SafeIconI: Image component that swaps to a fallback icon when the source fails or is empty.
frontend/src/components/i18n/BilingualTe: Displays English and regional-language text stacked with customizable styling.
frontend/src/components/i18n/I18nProvide: i18n context provider mapping states to languages and exposing a translation lookup function.
frontend/src/components/jobs/JobBoard.ts: Fetches and displays approved job posts with bilingual title and call button.
frontend/src/components/landing/FooterBa: Footer with bilingual text, contact link, app info, and branding credits.
frontend/src/components/landing/HeaderBa: Top navigation bar with state selector, page links, app name, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/workers/WorkerCa: UI component displaying a worker’s photo, details, and contact actions with bilingual labels and verification badge.
Defines category groups and subcategories for local skilled workers with labels and icon paths.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminMutations.ts: Provides admin mutation hooks for approving, rejecting, verifying, and featuring workers and jobs, with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity context and provider handling login, identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Query hooks to fetch workers, jobs, and admin status using the backend actor with error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useWorkerSearch.ts: Hook to search workers by area, category, or subcategory using prioritized filtering via actor APIs.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive CSS variables for theming plus base typography and utility styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Renders the admin panel with worker and job post review tabs, protected by AdminGuard.
frontend/src/pages/AllovikaasLandingPage: Empty placeholder page with no content.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Implements the landing page with search, category navigation, and bilingual UI text.
frontend/src/pages/JobRequestPage.tsx: Provides a job request form with validation, submission to backend, and success handling.
frontend/src/pages/WorkerRegistrationPag: Contains a worker registration form with photo upload, validation, and backend submission.
frontend/src/pages/WorkerSearchResultsPa: Displays worker search results with filters for area, category, and subcategory.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and clearing them from hash-based routes.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme colors, radii, shadows, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing the AREA WORKER platform requirements, design notes, issues, and needed icon assets.
